scripts.prettier-diff-fancy: for file in $(npx prettier --list-different resources/); do echo "\n\033[1;36m=== $file ===\033[0m"; npx prettier "$file" | diff -u "$file" - | diff-so-fancy; done
scripts.format-apply-with-diff: for file in $(npx prettier --list-different resources/); do echo "\n\033[1;36m=== $file ===\033[0m"; npx prettier "$file" | diff -u "$file" - | diff-so-fancy; npx prettier --write "$file"; echo "\033[0;32m✓ Archivo formateado\033[0m"; done
